text: Weird creatures emerged from a hovering egg-shaped spacecraft. The creatures were five feet high, had pointed ends, two eyes, and a hole below the eyes. One of them made a buzzing sound. The spaceship was oblong, our egg-shaped, with a pulsating blue light. Three creatures emerged from an opening in the front of the ship.
